explication: Ollamac is a native macOS chat client for a locally available Ollama server. Users select or create a chat, choose a model, submit prompts, and receive streamed responses; chats and messages are represented in SwiftData. Settings and per-chat preferences configure the Ollama host and system prompt, while assistant-message rendering supports Markdown and optional syntax highlighting. The graph follows relationships shown in excerpts and the SOURCE INDEX; unsampled implementations are represented only where their paths and connections are documented there.
